answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 168211 Country: India Title: What is the meaning baby girl name Ayra? Question: What is the meaning baby girl name Ayra? Answer ID: 168211 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 662/544/B=05/1440) Neither we could find the meaning of the word Ayra in a dictionary nor we know its meaning. You may choose any name among these names: Amirah, Sabirah, Asiya, Fauzia, Ghazalah, Fatimah, Ayesha etc. these names are among the best names. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
